title: Gate self-service onboarding and tenant isolation
acceptance_criteria: Implement lazy owner auth/onboarding routes and atomic onboarding of one unpublished tenant per owner, a neutral catalog copy and 14-day UTC trial; publishing requires confirmation.

Enforce reserved/canonical/retired slug rules and scoped constraints, composite foreign keys, and owner-derived repository scope. Test concurrent claims/renames and cross-tenant isolation against real PostgreSQL.

Prove route precedence, alias/query/hash behavior and standalone/iframe preservation. Unknown or invalid paths are not found; known unavailable and transport errors are distinct; live stays unavailable until its gate and never falls back to demo.
deliverables: Onboarding UI and API, slug registry, tenant scope contract, and route/DB gate evidence
